description: This file defines the WorkspaceRepository class which provides operations for managing and retrieving workspace trees, including loading, caching, and computing hierarchical relationships within a Drupal module.

classes.name: WorkspaceRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to load, cache, and manage hierarchical workspace data within Drupal.

methods.name: loadTree
methods.description: Loads the workspace hierarchy tree, utilizing cache if available, and constructs the tree structure with depth, ancestors, and descendants information.

methods.name: getDescendantsAndSelf
methods.description: Returns the specified workspace and all its descendant workspaces.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Invalidates the cached workspace tree and resets the internal cache state.
